category: crypto market data API (prices, market cap, volume, exchanges, onchain DEX data)

free_tier.stated: Demo plan USD 0/month: 10,000 call credits per month at 100 calls per minute, 1 API key, daily and hourly coin history for the past 1 year; a keyless public API also answers at about 5 calls per minute per IP
free_tier.notes: 1 call = 1 credit on every endpoint, and requests are counted from the first day of the calendar month to the last. Every request counts toward the per-minute limit, 4xx and 5xx answers included. The keyless public API (api.coingecko.com/api/v3 with no key, and api.geckoterminal.com/api/v2 for onchain DEX data) shares an IP-based pool of about 5 calls per minute that varies with server load; a keyless request past 365 days of history answered HTTP 401 with error_code 10012. The cheapest paid plan is Basic: paid plans start at USD 35/month with 100,000 calls a month at 300 calls per minute, and a second pricing table shows Basic at USD 29/mo billed yearly.

per_object_cap.stated: 1 year of daily and hourly history per coin on Demo and on the keyless API; 13+ years from 2013 on paid tiers

retention.stated: not applicable: a query API with no stored objects

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the 10,000 calls a month bound what a Demo key can pull

interface_detail: GET https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/... with the Demo key in x_cg_demo_api_key (header or query); paid keys use pro-api.coingecko.com and x_cg_pro_api_key. The same root answers with no key at the keyless rate. WebSocket is on paid plans only.
tooling: curl or any HTTP client; the website's historical-data page exports up to 1 year per coin as CSV or XLS
chaining: Crypto prices and market caps for a year back at 10,000 calls a month; it pairs with a stock or economic source such as Tiingo or FRED when a model mixes asset classes.

limits.value: 10,000 calls per calendar month on the Demo plan
100 calls per minute on the Demo plan
about 5 calls per minute per IP on the keyless public API, shared by every caller on that IP

limits_note: History window: daily and hourly coin data reach back 1 year on Demo and keyless (a 400-day keyless request answered error_code 10012); no limits kind names a history window. Bulk path: no bulk path; the per-coin CSV/XLS export on the website covers 1 year.
binding_note: 100 calls a minute would spend the month's 10,000 credits in 100 minutes, so the monthly count binds first.

identity_cost.detail: A Demo key needs a CoinGecko account: Google, Apple, or an email with a password of at least 8 characters (one uppercase, one lowercase, one number, one special character), with an email confirmation step; the pricing page says no credit card is required. The keyless public API needs no account and no key.

reliability_note: A call past the per-minute limit answers HTTP 429; keyless limits are shared per IP and vary with server load, so a shared egress address meets 429 sooner.
confidence_note: The Demo quota, rate and history depth are documented on the pricing page and the rate-limit page. Two keyless probes measured the public API: a price answered HTTP 200 and a 400-day history answered 401 with the 365-day limit. The 10,000-call cut-off needs a Demo key to measure.
